title: Replying to @Nat Wheels  He was cringe on Glee, but I think this was ...
transcript: We're not here to enjoy ourselves. Yikes. It's the Grinch that USA Today called bad enough to ruin Christmas. Viewers complain that the Grinch's performance was over the top sexual, bizarrely sexual interpretation of the Grinch. And I'm literally gonna need to see my therapist after watching Matthew Morrison put so much sexual energy into the Grinch that makes me. Morrison says he used Joaquin Phoenix's Joker character as inspiration.
